knowledge.purpose: Shows the current local time for a list of named IANA timezones, ticking live client-side.
useCases: Global office / distributed-team clocks widget (Clocks module)
antiPatterns: Not for scheduling/booking across timezones — pair with a form/calendar block for that
Timezone identifiers must be valid IANA names (e.g. 'Europe/Istanbul') — invalid ids silently fall back to the browser's local time

jsonSchema.description: Time-zone list: [{label, timezone}] with an IANA zone, e.g. {label:'Istanbul', timezone:'Europe/Istanbul'} — live tick via Intl.DateTimeFormat.
12-hour (true) or 24-hour (false) clock. Unset: the app's locale decides: en-GB and most of Europe read 24-hour, en-US 12-hour.
Show the seconds ticking (default false — a wall of clocks reads hours and minutes).

The moment the clocks show, as an ISO date-time with its offset ("2026-11-17T09:05:00Z"), instead of now. For an app whose day is fixed in its content: the clocks agree with the date the page states, and stand still. Unset: live.
